## Deviations
### 2026-11-03 (before any headline experiment; no real generation had been produced)
1. **Small tier: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct replaced by Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct.** Reason: licence. The 3B is under the Qwen research licence (non-commercial); the 1.5B and 7B are Apache-2.0, matching Sieve's MIT licence. The full ladder (f16, Q8_0, Q4_K_M, Q3_K_M, Q2_K) exists for the 1.5B. This is the fallback the pre-registration already named, now primary.
2. **Large tier file:** bartowski's single-file Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct Q4_K_M (an importance-matrix quant), instead of Qwen's split files. SHA-256 is verified against the Hub at download.
3. **Prompt:** a fixed few-shot QA prompt (`qa-v2-fewshot`) with an `Answer:` prefix replaces the earlier raw prompt (`qa-v1`), because the T4 smoke test showed the 7B opening with a preamble (D-016). Decoding is greedy, generation stops at the first newline, `-np 1 -c 4096 -ngl 99`, flash-attention on for quantised KV, `cache_prompt` off.
4. **Threshold path:** the fixed-sequence path is the split-A Pareto frontier of (threshold pair) points ordered by split-A coverage, with points below 5% A-coverage dropped, fixed before split B is read. This is a specific choice within the LTT framework; validity does not depend on it, power does.
5. **Operational choices the document left open** (listed in `docs/evaluation.md`): H3 "matches" read as a +-0.02 non-inferiority margin; "matched coverage" uses split-A-derived thresholds; H5 "before violation" means the label-free drift alarm fires; re-split 0 is the canonical split for bootstraps; MMLU-Redux uses `error_type == "ok"` rows only; the SimpleQA judge prompt is our own wording; the query-only router is TF-IDF plus logistic regression.

synthetic_label: SYNTHETIC DATA: produced by the offline fake backend; not a measurement of any LLM

verdicts.rule: Across 50 re-splits, test risk on C > alpha=0.1 in <= 15% of certified splits (SUPPORTED); > 25% (NOT SUPPORTED: bug or non-exchangeability); in between or fewer than 10 certified splits: INCONCLUSIVE.
verdicts.title: validity

verdicts.rule: SUPPORTED if mean_logprob or a margin signal beats max_prob by >= 0.02 AUROC with a paired 95% CI excluding 0; NOT SUPPORTED if every single-token signal is within +-0.02 of max_prob; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
verdicts.title: signal
verdicts.why: all single token signals within +-0.02 of max_prob

verdicts.rule: SUPPORTED if (a) the correct-answer rate (answered and correct, per item, i.e. coverage-aware) vs L-only is non-inferior (lower paired CI >= -0.02; accuracy-on-answered at differing coverage is reported but not decisive), (b) cost per correct answer incl. wasted S attempts is lower with the CI below 0, (c) the gate beats the matched-coverage random router and (d) query-only router (paired CI of accuracy-on-answered difference > 0). NOT SUPPORTED if indistinguishable from the random router (CI includes 0 or below) or the point estimate of the cost advantage is lost. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
verdicts.title: cascade value

verdicts.rule: SUPPORTED if k=5 self-consistency adds >= 0.03 AUROC over the best token signal (paired CI lower bound > 0; the frontier benefit additionally needs k x cost_S < cost_L, reported); NOT SUPPORTED if the CI upper bound is below the margin; else INCONCLUSIVE.
verdicts.title: self-consistency

verdicts.rule: SUPPORTED if the certified policy's risk exceeds alpha=0.1 on NQ-open (95% CI lower bound > alpha), exceeds NQ-open's risk on SimpleQA Verified, and the label-free drift alarm (KS on 50-query windows) fires on >= 80% of shifted windows. NOT SUPPORTED if the guarantee holds on NQ-open (CI upper bound <= alpha) or the alarm is blind (< 80% of shifted windows). 'Before violation' is operationalised as: the alarm uses scores only and is therefore available before any label.
verdicts.title: shift

verdicts.rule: SUPPORTED if a threshold fitted on the f16 reference violates alpha in > delta of re-splits on some quantized config while per-config recalibration does not (<= delta). NOT SUPPORTED if for all configs delta-AUROC and delta-ECE are equivalent within +-0.02 (90% paired-bootstrap CI inside the margin, TOST) and transferred thresholds hold in >= 1-delta of re-splits. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (partial support is reported in the numbers).
verdicts.title: quantization
verdicts.why: neither the shift nor the equivalence criterion is met for all configs

verdicts.rule: SUPPORTED if gate AUROC on MMLU-Redux < 0.6 (95% CI upper bound < 0.6); NOT SUPPORTED if the CI lower bound >= 0.6; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Reported as a limitation either way.
verdicts.title: hard sets
